description: Dataset for "Sequential Feature Selection for Power System Event Classification Utilizing Wide-Area PMU Data is a data set deposited in bl.qub by its authors Mark Rafferty (Queen's University Belfast). This dataset supports our paper 'Sequential Feature Selection for Power System Event Classification Utilizing Wide-Area PMU Data' submitted to Frontiers in Energy Research. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2022. Formats: ZIP. Size stated: 179MB. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
